messages:
maria: quick alert 0 mins ago we flipped strict fncall validation on the canary eu-west slice and rejects jumped. seeing ~6% rejects vs ~0.4% on baseline. not sure it's input drift.

josh: ugh. can you share the top failure examples and panel link? is it rejects vs fallback reroutes vs degen path?

maria: panel: https://console.redwood.internal/d/validators/euwest?panel=fncall_rejects (slice=canary-eu). metric is validator.rejects. also a correlated bump in fallback->degen_count. example payload from trace sample: 
```json
{"tool_response": ["ok","done"], "validation_error": "expected object for tool_response, got array"}
```

kevin: that's the smoking gun 0 some of our adapter integrations are returning arrays when they should return an object. question: how are these rejects being attributed in telemetry and billing? original route or final degen route?

sara: traces show route_id remains the original model route for billing, but the post-validate router tags the request as degen for the console. our panels currently display final route_tag which makes it look like the degen path is taking the cost, while billing spreadsheets show original route. confusing to customers.

rollout-bot: Canary 'strict-validate-v2' in eu-west: automatic pause triggered (reject_rate > 2.5% for 3/5 mins) 0 paused by system.

maria: immediate asks before we unpause: (1) add a reject_reason histogram to the rollout panel (human labels), with a link to sampled traces for the top buckets; (2) a clear billing attribution flag in the rollout UI/billing dashboard (are rejects billable?). both will reduce CS handoffs.

josh: implementation notes: logs emit `validator.code` currently (machine token). UI needs human labels (e.g. TOOL_SHAPE_ARRAY_INSTEAD_OF_OBJ). trace sampling is 1/100 right now for rejects. recommend bumping sampling to 1/10 for canary slices for the next 2 hours to collect examples.

kevin: infra plan: normalize common adapter shapes on the validation pipeline to emit a canonical `reject_reason` string. I can ship a normalizer under a feature flag (beta) and add a header `X-Validate-Sample: 1` that SDKs can set to force sampling for a request. will also log original_route_id + final_route_tag so we can disambiguate in telemetry.

sara: UX tweak: rollout detail should show two counters side-by-side: `rejects (original route)` and `rejects (post-validate fallback)`. that stops the guessing game and feeds into billing attribution.

maria: filing PLAT-3322: "euwest strict-validate follow-up: reject_reason histogram + sample trace links + billing attribution flag". assign @josh @kevin @sara. acceptance: histogram with human labels, trace link for top N buckets, side-by-side reject counters, and a billing flag saying "rejects counted as billable: yes/no".

josh: i'll prototype the histogram and trace link today using the diag-panel component. low-risk UI change.

kevin: i'll add the normalizer and sampling header; will flip feature flag for canary only. will also emit `original_route_id` in validation logs to make attribution easy.

sara: added sample traces to PLAT-3322 for QA. tagging @support so they can prep comms if we unpause and residual rejects occur.

maria: TL;DR: do not unpause strict-validate in eu-west until we have histogram + trace link + explicit billing attribution. sync in 20m in #eng-platform. :thumbsup:
